svg.aria-label: esaKITs IPA Keyboard 日本語版 アイコン。子音37記号、母音23記号のIPA抜粋。
svg.title: esaKITs IPA Keyboard — 日本語版
svg.desc: Orange beveled frame, purple patterned background, diagonal three-dimensional keyboard. 37 consonant symbols and 23 vowel symbols are selected from the official IPA chart. All symbols are Unicode in this source; the production SVG converts glyphs to precise vector outlines. This is an excerpt, not the full IPA chart.
